requirement: Widget grounds own build status and restores encrypted account-bound context without replay

oracle.invariant: Inspect requires session, editing grant, matching job/site and creator account before SELECT-only return; no host calls or handover writes. Unknown persisted states are unavailable; completion links come from persisted server facts. Signed-in model tools and actions cannot open sign-in; current-status tool accepts no arbitrary IDs. Encrypted context binds visitor, account, revision, purpose and expiry; tampered metadata refuses, expired context rotates visitor and CAS conflicts never retry. Locked same-account reauthentication hydrates history/build; another account sees no old context. Turn inflight is durable before inference; final history is durable before response; a restart returns uncertain words for manual review without inference replay. Real PostgreSQL scratch database applies migration126, verifies encrypted envelope excludes authentication data, races CAS with one winner, and permits inspect inside a READ ONLY transaction.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
